name: clics
description: CLICS monorepo root — one-command local dev runner for the 4 layers. Each layer keeps its own package.json/deps; this is NOT an npm workspace (deploys still target each layer dir).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,rimpl,portal,dash -c blue,magenta,green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix rimpl run dev" "npm --prefix physician-ui run dev" "npm --prefix audit-dashboard run dev -- -p 3002"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix rimpl install && npm --prefix physician-ui install && npm --prefix audit-dashboard install
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix rimpl run test:ci && npm --prefix license-verifier test && npm --prefix audit-dashboard test
scripts.test:booth-scripts: node --test scripts/booth/score-latency.test.mjs scripts/booth/purge-summary.test.mjs scripts/booth/sandbox-verdict.test.mjs scripts/booth/sandbox-noise.test.mjs scripts/booth/path-table.test.mjs scripts/booth/open-dataset.test.mjs
scripts.test:manuals: node --test scripts/manuals/lib/parse.test.mjs scripts/manuals/lib/pii-gate.test.mjs && node scripts/manuals/build.mjs --check && node scripts/manuals/verify-labels.mjs && node scripts/manuals/prose-audit.mjs
scripts.test:calibration: node --check scripts/calibration/three-way.js && node --check scripts/calibration/anchors/score-local.mjs && node --check scripts/calibration/anchors/revalidate.mjs && node --check scripts/calibration/anchors/import-sandbox.mjs && node --check scripts/calibration/anchors/import-shadow.mjs && node --check scripts/calibration/anchors/sandbox-import-lib.mjs && node --check scripts/calibration/anchors/sandbox-db.mjs && node --test scripts/calibration/three-way.test.mjs scripts/calibration/anchors/anchors.test.mjs scripts/calibration/anchors/sandbox-import.test.mjs
